claim: Google's quarter ended September 2025 operating income was $31.2 million.
summary: Google (Alphabet) Q3 2025 operating income was ~$31 billion, not $31.2 million. The claimed value understates magnitude by ~1000x.

sub_claims.text: Google's quarter ended September 2025 operating income was $31.2 million.
sub_claims.note: Alphabet/Google quarterly operating income in 2025 was on the order of tens of billions of dollars, with Q3 2025 ~$31 billion, not ~$31 million. The claim is off by ~1000x, confusing millions with billions.
